content: Yɛsu kàkyään mbwabà a ndwà a Nzam
Umpal kàkäl Yɛsu mutoo u ndwà a Nzam, umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki ande kàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, le! In'kul nà myàkölàköl, ndwà nà yàkölàköl! »
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ngye akimanà ndwà a kölàköl yi! Akà nkɔŋ mwɛy ifàsàsal anki udu a nkɔŋ yumwɛy. Ya yanswà ikyer asàbwabà. »
Ngyɛb anà nkwaaŋ
Yɛsu kàkäl aŋàbwaay u mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive, kusà a ndwà a Nzam. Petɔlà, Zyak, Ywan anà Andrɛ bun'fuulà ukɔl naa:
« Isam, mpal nà ndaa ayi isàyà, idiim nà isàswaŋ naa indiir abi byanswà ikyer asàkwo. »
Apan, Yɛsu kàsɛmà mutɛn a ba naa: « Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, mbuur twon amàlakur.
Ntɔn baar mbɔɔn bàsàyà kà ikɔb amɛ, waa bàsàtɛn naa: "Wà mɛ", waa ba bàsàkur baar mbɔɔn.
Mpal làsàwem bɛ làsaŋ a ità anà in'bää a ità, twon lan'man bɔɔmà: yubwaŋ naa bya itàyà, wɛɛ bya kà isàkal ntsüü anki.
Ntɔn un'sɛŋ mwɛy asànwaan a un'sɛŋ wumwɛy, imwol mwɛy a imwol kyumwɛy, kà ikal imwɛy imwɛy, mɛɛn ikyer asàtɛɛr, ngyal ikyer asàkal. Indiir abi byanswà byà nsɛmà a in'swaŋ.

Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ. Bàkyer asàlayälà u mbay a nsaŋ anà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, basàlakam iki, bɛ làsàkàsà in'lɔn kusà a amfum a itiir a mɛɛn anà kusà a amfum a nsi ntɔn mɛ: kya isàkal imbäl ntɔn ba.
Ntɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ bàkyer atàkyään la akà in'sɛŋ myanswà.
Mpal bàsàlasyen ntɔn mukàlayälà, twon lan'kyɛɛr kusà naa bɛ nkye làyàkàtɛn, wɛɛ ya bàsàlapà utaaŋ alan, làtɛn ya. Ntɔn kà bɛ anki làsàtwey mun, wɛɛ Dweelà Inkyɛɛl.
Un'tɔŋ asàyälà un'tɔŋ ande ntɔn bun'dwä, taa asàyälà mwan ande, baan bàsàbɛy aböör aba, waa bàsatsüül ukwà.
Baar banswà bàkyer asàlayiiŋ ntɔn ikɔb amɛ. Wɛɛ mbuur asàkaŋ mpem tii u ntsüü, asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Mpay aŋàdiir
« Mpal làsàman bɛ lingyoomà aŋàdiir lan'bwaay kà ikal mpa lan'kwo la mukal, - wɛy mbuur akataŋà uyöb! Apan, wɛy baar bàsàkal u Yuday, bàtiin uboo a myɔŋ,
wɛy mbuur asàkal udu a mpaan a ndwà, ukɔɔn asàtɔlà ntɔn muwal undiir u ndwà ande,
wɛy mbuur asàkal u ywaŋ, ukɔɔn afurà ndwà ntɔn mukàwal ipfɛy ande.
Ngyɛb akà akaar bàsàkal anà an'yöm anà akakaar bàsànüü ilä abin!
Làyamà naa ndaa ayi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n asàyà u paŋà a làbe!
Ntɔn, ilä abin isàkal ilä a mpay aŋàdiir mpa aŋàtàman fà nsɛmà a mɛɛn kàkyer Nzam tii papanà, anà ya ifàsàkal anki akà ikikye.
Yàlàkal naa Mwol ukɔɔn atyey ilä abi, akà mbuur mwɛy mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàlàwà anki. Wɛɛ, ntɔn baar kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde, nde kàtyey ilà abi.
Abun, isàkal naa mbuur kan'tɛn a bɛ naa: "Le, Klistɔ awà kà!" Itàkal naa: "Le, awunà kunà!", twon làmukyey.
Ntɔn Aklistɔ a loor anà aŋangɔɔm a loor bàkyer asàtoo, waa bàsàkyer idiim anà impà ntɔn mukur, itàkal sye baar aŋàsɔɔl, kya mbwo isàkal.
Abun bɛ, bɛ làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ! Indiir abi byanswà mɛ kàkyàlaweey kusà.
Ngyeel a Mwan a mbuur
« Wɛɛ kà ilä abin, ungö a mpay aŋàdiir ayin, taaŋ làsàbwà làpib, nsöŋ ufàsàpà anki kyɛɛy awa,
mbwaar isàfà du waa isàbwà, ngwal a du ikyer asàni.
Apan ba bàsàman Mwan a mbuur wàmuyà uboo a un'böŋ unsà ngwal mbɔɔn anà làkoo.
Apan nde asàtɔm akyeey anà asàböbà baar kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde kà an'twɛrà man'nà, fà nswɛŋ a mɛɛn tii u nswɛŋ a du.
An'lɔɔŋ a un'te a fige
« Làyöb lwɛŋ lan'fà uboo a nsim a un'te a fige: an'kɔkà màsàbulà bɔɔlàbɔɔl, nkay isàfulà, bɛ lan'yöb naa un'tye wà tsütsü.
Asànaa bɛ sye, mpal làsàman bɛ indiir abi byan'yà, làyöb naa Mwan a mbuur wà tsütsü u munàmbwo.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään: nkööl ayi isàlyaŋ anki kusà ndaa ayi yanswà mukwo.
Du anà mɛɛn màkyer asàlyaaŋ, wɛɛ ndaa amɛ isàlyaaŋ anki akà ikikye.
Nzam mpɛl ayöb ilä a ntsüü
« Wɛɛ ilä kya itàkal taaŋ la, akà mbuur mwɛy uyöb anki bya, itàkal akyeey a du, itàkal Mwan, akà mbuur mwɛy, nà Taa mpɛl.
Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, làduub mii abɛ, ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki mpal nà ya isàkwo.
Ya isàkal asànaa mbuur mwɛy kan'kàlyaaŋ: nde an'sàwɛy ndwà ande, an'sàpà ikɔ̈b akà asyääl ande, mbuur mbuur anà isal ande, waa uswaŋ un'kyɛɛŋ a munàmbwo muduub mii.
Lalan, làduub mii, ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki mpal usàyà nkum a ndwà, làsisye lɛɛ u mpöŋàmpöŋ, u mbeel a nkɔ lɛɛ u tutu,
manà nde uyà kà imbürà, waa kàlaman bàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Ndaa in'tɛɛnà mɛ yi a bɛ, mɛ in'tɛɛnà a baar banswà: Làduub mii! »
